about: Rock Paper Scissors at 48000 Hz, as SCENARIOS in render.mjs plays it, with the reverb and the compressor in. Per 2 s window from the frame the game starts the music on: measure() of each channel, once where the two are identical, and the difference between browsers, under the music and as its own level. Chromium and WebKit, rendered in lockstep, are what a render is held to; Firefox, laid out ahead, is recorded beside them, never held to.
